extensions.name: CachyOS Proton
extensions.summary: Runs Windows games in Steam, with CachyOS's own fixes and tuning.
caveats: VaporOS adds it for you and keeps it apart like every extension. Pick another Proton for a single game in that game's Steam properties.

extensions.name: CoolerControl
extensions.summary: Fan curves for your CPU, case fans, liquid cooler and graphics card, set from a web page.
caveats: When it stops or you remove it, VaporOS puts every fan back to how it was before CoolerControl started.
Some motherboard fan chips and the graphics card's fan curve need an option below, which takes a restart.

settings.label: Graphics card fan curve
settings.help: Lets CoolerControl set an AMD card's fan curve. This turns on the card's overclocking controls, so a wrong setting there can make the card unstable.

settings.label: Motherboard fan chip (it87)
settings.help: Makes fans on some ITE chips show up. The chip is then shared with the board's firmware, which may rarely read wrong sensor values.

copy.install: CoolerControl runs as a system service with full control of your fans, pump and GPU fan. Sign in to it with your VaporOS password.
copy.remove: Fans go back to the BIOS settings. Its profiles stay unless you also delete its settings.

extensions.name: TruckersMP
extensions.summary: Multiplayer for Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator.
caveats: TruckersMP doesn't support Linux; it runs here through Proton.
TruckersMP supports one version of each game. When Steam updates ETS2 or ATS before TruckersMP does, switch the game to the supported version until it catches up.

downloads.what: each new version of the TruckersMP mod
the list of the mod's files and their checksums
TruckersMP's current version and the game versions it supports

confirm.title: Copy your Linux profiles?
confirm.body: Profiles saved only on this PC are copied to the Windows version of ETS2 and ATS. Profiles already there stay as they are.

confirm.title: Switch to the version TruckersMP supports?
confirm.body: Steam downloads the version of ETS2 or ATS that TruckersMP supports when it next restarts. Your profiles stay. When TruckersMP supports a newer version, switch again.

confirm.title: Switch to the latest version?
confirm.body: Steam updates ETS2 and ATS to their latest version when it next restarts. TruckersMP may not support it yet.

copy.install: Steam downloads ETS2 and ATS again as their Windows version. Profiles saved only on this PC stay with the Linux version; copy them over from this card.
copy.remove: ETS2 and ATS keep running with Proton. To go back to their Linux version, turn off the compatibility tool in each game's Steam properties; Steam downloads it again.

extensions.name: Star Citizen
extensions.summary: Adds Star Citizen to Steam. Its first start installs the RSI Launcher, which then downloads the game.
caveats: Easy Anti-Cheat isn't tested on VaporOS yet.
Star Citizen wants 16 GB of memory, and 48 GB of memory and swap together. With less, it may stutter or close.

downloads.what: PowerShell, which the RSI Launcher uses

settings.label: Game drive
settings.help: Where Star Citizen keeps its game, which needs 150 GB free. Without a game drive, it goes on the system drive. Pick it before the restart that adds Star Citizen: it doesn't move later.

copy.install: Star Citizen needs a drive with 150 GB free, formatted as ext4, btrfs, xfs or f2fs. Pick it on its card before the restart that adds it, or it goes on the system drive. VaporOS then downloads the RSI Launcher's installer, and the first start in Steam installs the launcher.
copy.remove: Its shortcut leaves Steam. Deleting its downloads also deletes the RSI Launcher and the game from its drive, which can be more than 100 GB.
